artworks.title: Two Bathers
artworks.medium: transparent watercolor and colored crayons on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two nude figures in an open natural setting. Both individuals have short, dark hair. One figure is seated with their knees bent, while the other figure stands with one arm reaching towards their head. The figures lack detailed facial features and are surrounded by vibrant green foliage, a body of water, and a blue sky.

artworks.title: Standing Girl in Water and the Other Sitting on Shore (Im Wasser stehendes und am Ufer sitzendes Madchen mit Hut)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two nude individuals. Both figures are depicted from the side, with one seated and the other standing. The seated person has a triangular hat or hair covering their head and their face has minimal features, while their limbs are bent as they sit. The standing figure has shoulder-length hair with clear lines and texture, and their facial features are simple with a pronounced nose and long lashes. The setting includes angular shapes for foliage and lines representing ground or water, with the background being abstract. The sketch is signed by Otto Mueller.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve (Adam und Eva)
artworks.medium: lithograph with scraping on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays bold, jagged lines and angular shapes, forming an abstract composition that suggests the outlines of two human figures. The figures appear elongated and in exaggerated postures, resembling statues or sculptures. The sharp angles and contrasting dark and light areas create a dynamic interplay, evoking a sense of abstract natural environment.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting in a chair with his head turned slightly to the left. He has long gray hair, a beard, and a mustache. He is wearing a dark coat and light pants, and is seated at a table with stacks of papers or books. The background includes a decorative element and a calendar displaying "28." The style is monochromatic and sketchy.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Boy Fishing
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over leadpoint on laid eighteenth-century (Mariette) mount
artworks.description: The image shows a figure seated and drawing on the ground with a stick. The setting includes curved lines resembling terrain, trees on the left, a horizon with buildings, and a tower to the right. The color scheme is sepia-toned with detailed strokes for texture.

artworks.title: The Death of the Virgin
artworks.description: Nineteen people gathered around a woman who lies on a bed are drawn with delicate, silvery-brown lines on light aqua-tinted, horizontally oriented paper. The woman on the bed lies with her eyes closed and her body wrapped in cloth that covers everything except her face and hands, which are crossed. Eleven men and women wearing robes sit across the bottom of the sheet turned away from us or toward each other. Many have delicate lines suggesting halos. In the top right quadrant of the drawing, a woman covers her face with her hands, and a man resting his chin in his hand wraps an arm around a young child, who holds a chalice or vessel. Five more people are gathered on the far side of the bed. One holds a small bucket out and another holds an open book and a staff. There is discoloration on the paper at the bottom center, and dark lines across and up the middle suggest that the sheet may have been folded at some point.

artworks.title: Saint George and the Dragon
artworks.artist: Attributed to Hugo van der Goes
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 20 x 16.6 cm (7 7/8 x 6 9/16 in.)
support: 20.6 x 16.6 cm (8 1/8 x 6 9/16 in.)

artworks.title: Landscape with a Castle
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with white heightening on blue prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a castle on a hill. Mountains are visible on the horizon and the castle is centrally placed. The style appears to be a woodcut or engraving with detailed line work. The color scheme is primarily gray with subtle highlights on the clouds and vegetation. There are trees and a stream in the foreground, and the castle with tall towers stands out against the sky. In the distance, a boat with two figures can be seen on the water.

artworks.title: Landscape with Men Fishing
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with white heightening on blue prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a stream, vegetation, people near the water, a fence, buildings, hills, and a sky with clouds. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes creating texture in the foliage. The color palette consists mainly of blues and whites.

artworks.title: The Annunciation to Joachim
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a slightly elevated perspective, depicting a landscape with a sky above. The horizon is visible with textured clouds filling the upper part of the image. A winged figure is descending from above. The style is detailed and meticulous, resembling an etching or engraving. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and beige. In the foreground, there is a dog standing next to a kneeling figure interacting with the angel. Trees with detailed foliage are also present. In the background, a shepherd is with a flock near simplistic buildings.

artworks.title: The Rapids of the Danube near Grein
artworks.medium: pen with black and gray ink
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an elevated perspective. A large tree is prominent on the left side, with intricate branches and foliage. A body of water extends across the scene, reflecting gently rippling patterns. In the distance, a castle-like structure sits on a hill surrounded by hills and forests leading to the horizon. The horizon is high in the composition. A small boat with figures is on the water. The drawing uses a monochromatic palette of blacks and grays on a light beige background, emphasizing intricate line techniques.

artworks.title: The Baptism of Christ
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with light gold gouache on brown washed laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image shows two figures positioned outdoors on a natural surface. Both figures are shown fully from head to toe, in motion. One figure reaches outward with their arm, while the other figure's body is turned slightly away. Both figures have detailed facial features, with hair styled in loose curls. They are minimally clothed with fabric draped around their lower bodies. The background is plain with faint sketch lines hinting at a landscape.

artworks.title: Sketch for a Baptism of Christ
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash  (heightened with white?) on brown washed laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, one standing and the other kneeling on a rock. The standing figure faces slightly left with their head turned towards the other figure. They have a muscular body and curly hair. The kneeling figure leans towards the standing figure with an arm extended above the other figure's head. This figure also has defined musculature and curly hair. Both figures appear minimally clothed in draped fabrics around their waists. The background consists of simple, abstract lines and shading on a textured surface, without identifiable environmental details.

artworks.title: Sketch for a Baptism of Christ
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash  (heightened with white?) on brown washed laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring two robust figures interacting with a smaller figure in the foreground. The composition shows two figures, partially draped in cloth, engaged in an animated exchange. The figure on the left is in a dynamic pose, elevated on their toes with their torso leaning slightly forward. The figure on the right stands with an assertive stance, holding a circular object aloft. A smaller figure in the bottom right corner is kneeling or seated, observing the scene over their shoulder. The scene is rendered with flowing lines and soft brown tones, emphasizing the muscular forms and expressions of the figures. The neutral background highlights the figures' forms and actions.

artworks.title: Madame Dietz-Monnin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Albert J. Beveridge in memory of her aunt, Delia Spencer Field
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a semi-profile position, with a confident expression. They have short, dark hair and are wearing a wide-brimmed hat with a feather or decoration. The person is wearing a dark garment that wraps around their shoulders. The background is a muted brown color with soft, blended color marks.

artworks.title: Marie Leszczynska of Poland, Queen of France
artworks.artist: Laurent Cars after Carle Van Loo
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a woman's body in a portrait. She is facing forward in an ornate oval frame. The woman has a serene expression, soft cheeks, defined eyebrows, and styled hair with curls and an ornament. She wears a richly decorated dress with lace sleeves, a cloak, and intricate embroidery. Earrings dangle from her ears. In the background, there is a plain backdrop, an engraved oval frame with text, and a decorative element with a crown and laurel wreath.

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: The image depicts two female figures dressed in elaborate garments from the waist up. The taller person stands to the right, her body facing forward but her head turned slightly towards the viewer. Her facial features are delicate, with a slightly elongated face, soft eyes, and a composed expression. Her hair is styled upwards and adorned with decorative elements. She wears a high-necked dress with a prominently ruffled collar and sleeves, and intricate lace cuffs extending from her sleeves. The shorter figure stands to her left, with her body slightly turned towards the taller person. Her facial features are youthful, with a round face and alert eyes. Her hair is similarly styled, with curls framing her face. She wears a detailed gown with an elaborate floral design and a similar ruffled collar. This figure holds a flower in her right hand and a small bag in her left. The background features an opulent interior setting, with a leaded glass window offering a view of a distant building and a vase with a flower arrangement on a tabletop beside elaborate drapery. The floor is adorned with an intricate patterned design.

artworks.title: Phillip II of Spain
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 30.8 x 23.2 cm (12 1/8 x 9 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a man. He faces the viewer in an upright posture. He has a full beard and mustache, giving him an aged appearance. His eyes are large and expressive, and he has a high forehead. He wears a tall, cylindrical hat with vertical stripes. He wears a fur-collared garment over a doublet with buttons, along with a ruffled collar. He has a chain around his neck with an ornament. The background has a simple, textured pattern.

artworks.title: Peter the Great of Russia
artworks.description: The image portrays a man in a military uniform, facing slightly to the right. He has prominent facial features, curly hair, and is holding a sword in his left hand, while the right hand rests on a large map. In the background, there is a faint image of a structure against a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: John the Fearless, Duke of Burgundy
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Claesz Soutman
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man standing in a three-quarter view, with his face turned slightly to the right. The man has distinct facial features, short hair, and is wearing a hat with a small floral decoration. He is dressed in a textured coat with a fur collar. The portrait is framed with floral and fruit motifs, including cherubs blowing trumpets. An inscription is visible below the portrait. The background is plain, emphasizing the details in the portrait and frame.

artworks.title: Maria Anna of Spain
artworks.artist: Jacob Louis after Pieter Claesz Soutman
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a person seated in a forward-facing position. The person has a composed facial expression with finely arched eyebrows, a slender nose, and delicate lips. Their hair is styled in a short, curly manner, forming neatly around the head. They are dressed in an elaborate garment featuring a large, ornate ruff collar and a richly decorated bodice adorned with pearls and intricate patterns. The figure wears an elaborate jeweled headpiece and a prominent medallion that hangs at the center of the chest, surrounded by layered strands of pearls. The background consists of a decorative frame with intricate floral and leaf motifs, creating an opulent border around the portrait.

artworks.title: Maria of Burgundy, Empress and Wife of Maximilian I
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Claesz Soutman
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a woman facing slightly to the right, with a full view of her face. She has an oval face shape, defined cheekbones, a sharp nose, and large eyes looking in the same direction. She wears an ornate headpiece with decorative patterns and a lacy edge. Her clothing appears rich, possibly a gown with pearls and intricate embroidery, and she wears a cross pendant. The portrait is framed with floral and ornamental designs, including carvings and floral motifs. The background features detailed floral garlands and drapery. A medallion with a coat of arms is above her head within the decorative elements encircling her portrait.

artworks.title: Marie Therese of Spain, Dauphine of France
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Jean-Baptiste Van Loo
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in an elaborate 18th-century gown with lace and embroidery details. She is standing in a regal setting with architectural elements, a piece of furniture with a crown, and a cloudy sky in the background.

artworks.title: Mary I Stuart
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Claesz Soutman after Gerrit van Honthorst
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the chest up, turned slightly to her left with her face towards the viewer. She has an oval-shaped face, large eyes, and a small mouth. Her long, wavy hair is parted in the middle and falls over her shoulders with a band across the top. She wears a garment with a lace collar and a pearl necklace. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate oval frame with cherubs and intricate details. Above the frame is a coat of arms and below is a line of text, set against a plain background.
